# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime reliability and platform updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves native-data safety, stream lifetime handling, and platform rendering support. It also reduces allocation during pixel copies and text shaping, updates Android rendering synchronization, and refreshes platform-native packaging.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Native data creation respects C-string bounds** — Creating SKData from C strings no longer reads past the native buffer and writes directly into the managed data object. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Corrects stream lifetime handling so front-buffered streams do not retain their underlying data longer than needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Image and text processing allocate less** — Optimizes managed pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding, and native feature-string handling to reduce transient allocation. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Apple deployment targets updated** — Raises the minimum Apple deployment targets used by the packages; update application targets as needed when adopting this release. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **WebGPU support is included in static native assets** — Packages the emdawnwebgpu implementation with libSkiaSharp.a so static consumers have the required WebGPU source. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Linux resolves bundled HarfBuzz functions locally** — Binds HarfBuzz functions from the bundled native library on Linux, avoiding reliance on an external system binding. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
